title: Plants or ferns - Manipulation & Hit
author: Vrymaa
changes: Real close-up recording of fern and herb leaves rustling as they are gathered by hand, used for the ladybug (ladybugs make no sound we can hear; this is the leafy rustle of the plants they live on). Trimmed to 1.60–4.30 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass: the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
